sig: increased the browser daemon sdk bundle size budget
item: Increased the browser daemon SDK bundle size budget to 191 KiB to accommodate new attachment metadata and fix build failures.

sig: adds experimental native live voice support webshell macos
item: Adds experimental native Live Voice support to WebShell on macOS, enabling real-time audio interactions via a dedicated global shortcut. (#7859) by @LaZzyMan

sig: improved workspace sendkeystrokes support binding keys for example
item: Improved workspace::SendKeystrokes to support re-binding keys. For example you can now do: "x": ["workspace::SendKeystrokes", "\" _ x"] in vim mode to ensure that x does not clobber your clipboard (#20277).

sig: fixed the cli reconnecting stale hub daemon after
item: Fixed the CLI reconnecting to a stale Hub daemon after an upgrade. Hub daemons now carry a runtime build fingerprint, so an upgraded CLI retires and respawns a daemon still running older code instead of attaching to it (from SDK v0.0.73)

sig: team runs the spawn tool longer exposed teammates
item: Team runs: the spawn tool is no longer exposed to teammates, and errored teammate runs now report as failed instead of completed (from SDK v0.0.65)

sig: edittool error message includes file path when parallel
item: EditTool Error Message Includes File Path: When parallel multi-file Edits fail, the error message now includes the specific absolute file path, no longer requiring you to dig through tool_call parameters to locate which file failed.

sig: exclusive edition model list anomaly fixed issue where
item: Exclusive Edition Model List Anomaly: Fixed an issue where enterprise ID parsing failed during custom-token login, causing the /model list to fall back to the built-in default models. The explicitly configured enterprise ID is now read first.

sig: more accurate request tracing fixed issue where multiple
item: More accurate request tracing: Fixed an issue where multiple model requests in multi-turn conversations reused the same set of request identifiers. Now each HTTP request generates an independent X-Request-ID, making it easier to trace request chains.

sig: fixed the issue where file suggestions included build
item: Fixed the issue where @ file suggestions included build artifacts ignored by .gitignore, as well as internal files of version control systems such as .svn / .hg. File candidates now prioritize files actually tracked by version control and proactively filter out version control internal directories, reducing noise from irrelevant files.

sig: glob tool fixed the issue where after ripgrep
item: Glob Tool: Fixed the issue where after ripgrep timed out and fell back to glob, the lack of a tool-level timeout caused permanent hangs on very large directories with no results. A tool-level timeout covering the entire search has been added as a safeguard

sig: model request timeout aligned the model request wait
item: Model request timeout: Aligned the model request wait time with the first Token timeout configuration, preventing requests from being prematurely cancelled at the default 10-minute mark.

sig: warmup process scanning wrong directory fixed issue where
item: Warmup process scanning wrong directory: Fixed an issue where the warmup process mistakenly scanned the wrong working directory during standby, producing massive directory scans and irrelevant reports. When the relevant capability is not enabled, no scanning is performed at all.

sig: staging environment login redirect fixed issue where login
item: Staging environment login redirect: Fixed an issue where login still targeted the production endpoint after /config -d switched to the staging environment, causing an immediate return to the login page after successful authentication

sig: lost team member model and tool settings fixed
item: Lost team member model and tool settings: Fixed an issue where reawakened team members fell back to the main conversation model and ignored disabled-tool settings. Background task agents are fixed as well

sig: file auto completion refresh fixed issue where newly
item: File Auto-Completion Refresh: Fixed an issue where newly added files were not suggested when typing @; the file list cache now automatically refreshes after expiration

sig: stream json output fixed issue where error messages
item: stream-json Output: Fixed an issue where error messages polluted the JSON stream in stream-json mode

sig: improved authentication third party acp clients including jetbrains
item: Improved authentication in third-party ACP clients, including JetBrains and Zed: both browser and manual sign-in now use the Devin auth flow, so the manual /login fallback works where it previously failed.

sig: responses silently truncated when the model hits its
item: Responses silently truncated when the model hits its max output token limit now show a warning and exit non-zero in pipe mode instead of returning partial output as if complete.

sig: fix fix conversation list order picker lazily load
item: fix: fix conversation list order in picker, lazily load conversation metadata, add get_user_conversations(), add ?limit= to /api/conversations and use it in webui (9c53aa0)

sig: correct the agent mid turn redirects hermes heading
item: Correct the agent mid-turn — redirects — If Hermes is heading the wrong way, you no longer have to /stop and re-explain. Type a correction while it works and the active turn is redirected: work in flight is preserved, the original prompt is kept, and the agent course-corrects with your new guidance. Paired with double-ESC draft discard and a composer undo stack, steering feels like editing, not restarting. (#63104, #72339, #74736 — @OutThisLife)

sig: introduced secondary agent the planning critic review all
item: We’ve introduced a secondary agent—the Planning Critic—to review all plans that do not require human intervention. Before Jules executes a single line of code, this agent rigorously critiques and refines the proposed plan. While this adds a small amount of time to the planning phase, the result is a 9.5% reduction in task failure rates and significantly higher quality execution paths.

sig: cli route source checkout build output stderr before
item: CLI: route source-checkout build output to stderr before launching OpenClaw commands so stale local builds do not corrupt --json stdout.

sig: gateway diagnostics enable payload free stability recording default
item: Gateway/diagnostics: enable payload-free stability recording by default and add a support-ready diagnostics export with sanitized logs, status, health, config, and stability snapshots for bug reports. (#70324) Thanks @gumadeiras.

sig: feishu webhook harden the webhook transport and card
item: Feishu/webhook: harden the webhook transport and card-action replay guards to fail closed on missing encryptKey and blank callback tokens — refuse to start the webhook transport without an encryptKey, reject unsigned requests when no key is present instead of accepting them, and drop blank card-action tokens before the dedupe claim and dispatcher. Defense-in-depth over the already-closed monitor-account layer. (#66707) Thanks @eleqtrizit.

sig: background tasks add the first linear task flow
item: Background tasks: add the first linear task flow control surface with openclaw flows list|show|cancel, keep manual multi-task flows separate from one-task auto-sync flows, and surface doctor recovery hints for obviously orphaned or broken flow/task linkage. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.

sig: agents models codify agents defaults model agents defaults
item: Agents/Models: codify agents.defaults.model / agents.defaults.imageModel config-boundary input as string | {primary,fallbacks}, split explicit vs effective model resolution, and fix models status --agent source attribution so defaults-inherited agents are labeled as defaults while runtime selection still honors defaults fallback. (#24210) thanks @bianbiandashen.

sig: fixed workspace http api query drift workspace routed
item: Fixed workspace HTTP API query drift so workspace-routed endpoints expose the right query parameters in OpenAPI and the SDK.

sig: fixed file mutation queue ordering concurrent edit and
item: Fixed file mutation queue ordering so concurrent edit and write operations targeting the same file stay serialized in request order instead of being reordered during queue-key resolution

sig: slash commands and hook commands now work during
item: Slash commands and hook commands now work during streaming: Previously, using a slash command or hook command while the agent was streaming would crash with "Agent is already processing". Now:

sig: windows binary path resolution fixed bun compiled binary
item: Windows Binary Path Resolution: Fixed Bun compiled binary on Windows failing to find package.json and other assets. The binary was incorrectly using the Bun runtime's virtual filesystem path (B:\~BUN\) instead of the actual executable location. Now uses process.execPath which correctly points to the compiled binary, and updated detection to check for %7EBUN (URL-encoded ~BUN) in import.meta.url.

sig: enhanced review command with test plan validation measured
item: Enhanced /review command with test plan validation, measured failure attribution, and new verification lenses to improve code change analysis. (#8215, #8218, #8225, #8261, #8315)

sig: added login option when plan retrieval fails and
item: Added a re-login option when plan retrieval fails, and fixed Key forced refresh not being triggered after login

sig: fixed issue where the file finder would jump

sig: allow sending message when selecting option provided the

sig: environment variable authentication conflict detection when codebuddy_api_key codebuddy_auth_token
item: Environment Variable Authentication Conflict Detection: When CODEBUDDY_API_KEY or CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN environment variables are set, the /login command automatically detects and suggests conflict resolution; authentication failures display more detailed diagnostic information to help quickly locate issues

sig: expanded tool token limits codex models now support
item: Expanded Tool Token Limits: codex models now support up to 10,000 tool output tokens. Configure this via tool_output_token_limit in config.toml.

sig: auth new cli auth storage abstraction with keyring
item: Auth: new CLI auth storage abstraction with keyring support and configurable backend.

sig: this release introduces new crush projects command that
item: This release introduces a new crush projects command that you can use to see all the projects where you used Crush that it knows about. Keep in mind that you need to start Crush at least once, with this new release, to get it recognized. It was primarily designed for programmatic use (see the --json flag, but maybe people will like it too). For details see crush projects --help).

sig: administrators can configure the cli outbound http proxy
item: Administrators can configure the CLI’s outbound HTTP proxy through the MDM-distributed enterprise policy file (system.json); it takes precedence over the user config, and the updater honors it too.

sig: devin worker start longer requires pre provisioned outposts
item: devin worker start no longer requires a pre-provisioned outposts token: with no --token / DEVIN_OUTPOSTS_TOKEN it creates an outpost with your CLI login and reuses the saved worker token on later runs.

sig: the default model now adaptive which automatically routes
item: The default model is now Adaptive, which automatically routes each turn to the best model for the task. You can still pick a specific model with /model or by setting agent.model in your config.

sig: add new foldertrust setting that the users can

sig: cli command add export command cli for markdown

sig: feat cli add context mode context include output

sig: plugins security replace dangerous code scanner enforcement with

sig: browser cli add openclaw browser evaluate timeout long
item: Browser CLI: add openclaw browser evaluate --timeout-ms so long-running page functions can extend both the evaluate action and request timeout budgets. (#83447) Thanks @eefreenyc.

sig: agents cache diagnostics add prompt cache break diagnostics
item: Agents/cache: diagnostics: add prompt-cache break diagnostics, trace live cache scenarios through embedded runner paths, and show cache reuse explicitly in openclaw status --verbose. Thanks @vincentkoc.

sig: commands doctor avoid rewriting invalid configs with new

sig: cli onboarding persist gateway token config local cli
item: CLI onboarding: persist gateway token in config so local CLI auth works; recommend auth Off unless you need multi-machine access.

sig: configurable same phone marker new inbound samephonemarker config
item: Configurable same-phone marker: New inbound.samePhoneMarker config option to customize the prefix added to messages in same-phone mode (default: [same-phone]). Set it to something cute like [? same-phone] to help distinguish bot replies.

sig: enabled node persistent compile cache before loading the
item: Enabled Node's persistent compile cache before loading the bundled CLI runtime, reducing repeat launch time.

sig: nix guix support pi_package_dir environment variable overrides the
item: Nix/Guix support: PI_PACKAGE_DIR environment variable overrides the package path for content-addressed package managers where store paths tokenize poorly. See README.md#environment-variables. (#1153 by @odysseus0)

sig: added http proxy environment variable support for api
item: Added HTTP proxy environment variable support for API requests (#942 by @haoqixu)

sig: append system prompt flag append additional text file
item: --append-system-prompt Flag: Append additional text or file contents to the system prompt. Supports both inline text and file paths. Complements --system-prompt for layering custom instructions without replacing the base system prompt. (#114 by @markusylisiurunen)

sig: feat cli add config key value slash command

sig: feat cli sdk expose context usage data non

sig: workspace flag new workspace path option specify custom

sig: added the agent prevent_idle_sleep setting enabled default prevent

sig: agent added disable_ai project setting allow disabling for
item: Agent: Added a disable_ai project setting to allow disabling AI for a specific project via .zed/settings.json. (#47902; thanks oliverbarnes)

sig: added auto_indent_on_paste setting which can used per language
item: Added auto_indent_on_paste setting, which can be used on a per-language basis, to configure whether indentation should be adjusted when pasting. This setting is enabled by default for languages other than YAML and Markdown (#20193).

sig: added regex option vim search command allow disabling
item: Added a regex option to vim::Search command to allow disabling regex search by default in the keymap (#19177; thanks osa1).

sig: added support for argument completions for context server
item: Added support for argument completions for context server prompts. These show up as regular completions to slash commands (#17085; thanks dsp-ant).

sig: improved expand excerpt indicators multi buffers allow unidirectional
item: Improved expand excerpt indicators in multi-buffers to allow unidirectional expansion. Also added the editor::ExpandExcerptsUp and editor::ExpandExcerptsDown actions, which can both take a lines parameter. Also added an expand_excerpt_lines setting which controls the default number of lines that the indicators and actions use.

sig: apply_patch add file against path that already exists
item: apply_patch "Add File" against a path that already exists is now rejected instead of silently overwriting it. Only UPDATE and DELETE targets were pre-loaded, so the parser's "File already exists" guard never saw ADD targets and the patch destroyed the file's contents with no error and no diff of what was lost

sig: the big refactor run_agent longer lines the file
item: The Big Refactor — run_agent.py is no longer 16,000 lines — The file at the heart of Hermes — the agent conversation loop — has been reduced from 16,083 lines to 3,821 (-76%), with the extracted code redistributed across 14 cohesive modules under agent/. Behavior is unchanged: every extraction keeps a thin forwarder on AIAgent, every test patch path still works, every external caller is compatible. The reason you care: future Hermes development moves faster, plugin authors can finally grep the codebase, and the file that took 90 seconds to load in your editor opens in a blink.

sig: the agent lints its own writes post write
item: The agent lints its own writes — post-write delta lint on write_file + patch. Python, JSON, YAML, TOML. Syntax errors surface immediately instead of shipping downstream.

sig: gateway config watcher handoff preserve pending config writes
item: Gateway config watcher handoff: preserve pending config writes until the watcher observes the committed generation, preventing config.patch from failing during same-write source handoff. Fixes #131405.

sig: plugin sdk add row level session workflow helpers
item: Plugin SDK: add row-level session workflow helpers and deprecate loadSessionStore so plugins can read and patch sessions without depending on the legacy whole-store shape. (#84693) Thanks @efpiva.

sig: snapshot revert fixed snapshot revert issues where overlapping
item: Snapshot Revert (#18093): Fixed snapshot revert issues where overlapping file changes could apply the wrong patch hash, and resolved a sorting bug in hidden file ordering.

sig: added edit tool multi edit support one call
item: Added edit tool multi-edit support so one call can update multiple separate, disjoint regions in the same file while matching all replacements against the original file content

sig: added support for multi line search and replace
item: Added support for multi-line search and replace input in Buffer Search and Project Search. (#50783; thanks claiwe)

sig: refreshed assistant markdown chat scaled headings quieter code
item: Refreshed assistant markdown — chat-scaled headings, quieter code blocks with a hover copy button, and table cards — now rendered through the same pipeline as the rest of Cline, so the desktop app and the cloud dashboard finally look alike.

sig: queue message command preservation slash commands are now
item: Queue Message Command Preservation: Slash commands are now preserved during message queue processing and executed through the normal pipeline once the agent is idle, preventing commands from being silently dropped

sig: the agent can now sign pay and fill
item: The agent can now sign in, pay, and fill addresses from 1Password, Bitwarden, or the local Hermes vault without ever seeing a secret; two-factor codes come from a saved authenticator key or are asked for in the user's UI (#106480, #107585). Private git plugins install with the user's stored credentials (#106981).

sig: you now full control when your code gets
item: You’re now in full control of when your code gets to GitHub. No need to wait for a task to finish or ask Jules to do it for you. At any point during a task, just click the GitHub icon in the top right to publish the current work-in-progress as a new branch or open a pull request. This gives you more flexibility and control to review, test, or take over whenever you’re ready.

sig: jules helps you move faster working autonomously tasks
item: Jules helps you move faster by working autonomously on tasks in your GitHub repo. It can fix bugs, update dependencies, migrate code, and add new features.

sig: linux desktop appimage and debian package published from
item: Linux desktop AppImage and Debian package: published from v2026.9.4 source 3a9d69db306cd7f081e06254cb89c4bcc14a7107. Build, packaged runtime smoke, and signing passed; GitHub asset upload was recovered using the exact successful CI artifacts. Public downloads match the checksums, and the AppImage signature was independently verified. The Linux updater manifest is published, and the stable update endpoint was verified at 2026.9.4.

sig: optional team activity reports install and enable team
item: Optional team activity reports: install and enable Team Reports to browse authenticated GitHub activity and explicitly configured Discord discussion, with stored history and optional model summaries. (#139850, #141327)

sig: dependencies add release dependency evidence reports npm advisory

sig: tencent yuanbao and qqbot support expand channel coverage

sig: line voice transcription classify m4a voice media audio

sig: cli add signal cli auto install from github
item: CLI: add Signal CLI auto-install from GitHub releases in the wizard and persist wizard run metadata in config.

item: Project-specific settings: Settings now load from both ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (global) and <cwd>/.pi/settings.json (project). Project settings override global with deep merge for nested objects. Project settings are read-only (for version control).

sig: added the verify capture mjs script generate evidence

sig: add lock toggle pin api config across all

We're now validating the issue and reporting it as an error to the model so it can correct itself. Of course, we also fixed the associated bug in Crush so sessions will no longer break.

sig: did you know mcp can support stored prompts

sig: devin mcp login succeeds against authorization servers that
item: devin mcp login succeeds against authorization servers that advertise RFC 9207 issuer identification, MCP connection setup times out instead of leaving later requests waiting on a stalled server, and MCP prompt commands no longer generate background requests every 15 seconds per conversation.

sig: feat admin prompt user restart the cli they

sig: acp client provided mcp servers editor integrations code

sig: agents custom providers preserve blank api keys for

sig: models auth setup token token auth profiles clawdbot

item: Improved mcp CLI and added ability to debug MCP OAuth (@elithrar)

item: Added support for configuring MCP servers that connect over HTTP in your settings file. These are not yet available in the extensions API. (#39021; thanks AhegaoBurger)

sig: agent added support delete and configure mcp servers

sig: models the live catalog that don report context

sig: fix regression the chatgpt oauth provider where requests
item: Fix a regression in the ChatGPT OAuth provider where requests failed with max_output_tokens not supported, by restoring the full output token budget instead of applying an implicit cap.

sig: make context shortening more intelligent when model hits
item: Make context shortening more intelligent when model hits context window–now old file contents are removed from conversation history rather than the first half of messages being removed altogether, resulting in narrative integrity and less "running into loops" issues.

sig: added two new reasoning models deepseek pro and
item: Added two new reasoning models, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash, both supporting a 1M context window, tool calling, and image understanding, further enriching the available base model matrix.

sig: history compaction boundary misidentification fixed issue where when
item: History Compaction Boundary Misidentification: Fixed an issue where, when conversations contained HTML collapsible blocks (<details><summary>...</summary>...</details>), messages were incorrectly identified as history compaction boundaries and subsequently excluded from real user input.

sig: context compaction switch compatibility optimized compatibility logic for
item: Context Compaction Switch Compatibility: Optimized compatibility logic for the compaction switch. When the new switch is explicitly disabled, it will no longer be incorrectly enabled by legacy configuration.

sig: compaction history size optimization engineering compaction summaries now
item: Compaction History Size Optimization: Engineering compaction summaries now omit the large new_string field of edit tools, reducing large code payloads in compaction history and lowering token consumption.

sig: lower memory usage long conversations fixed listener accumulation
item: Lower memory usage in long conversations: Fixed listener accumulation that caused memory leaks over time. Token estimation no longer repeatedly copies the entire history, and peak memory usage during the first save of long forked or team conversations has been significantly reduced

sig: windows platform fixes fixed command quote escaping the
item: Windows platform fixes: Fixed command-quote escaping in the status line, failures when running in directories containing spaces, blocking during bare-command resolution, and entire tool groups disappearing when some MCP services could not connect. Child-process management and memory usage have also been improved.

sig: local memory configuration added codebuddy local file support
item: Local Memory Configuration: Added CODEBUDDY.local.md file support for personal preference settings, excluded from version control

sig: agent tool configuration fixed file reading capability configuration
item: Agent Tool Configuration: Fixed file reading capability configuration issue for compact agent

sig: session recovery enhancement support displaying sessions generated compact
item: Session Recovery Enhancement: Support displaying sessions generated by /compact command, users no longer lose session history after compaction

sig: session state management optimization optimized lastmessageid update mechanism
item: Session State Management Optimization: Optimized lastMessageId update mechanism during async compaction, ensuring correct message ID association in long conversation scenarios, improving session recovery reliability

sig: context compaction stability fixed issue where message enqueuing
item: Context compaction stability: Fixed an issue where message enqueuing during automatic compaction prevented compaction from executing, and improved robustness of interrupt waiting. Also fixed internal continuation messages displaying incorrectly in the chat UI during compaction

sig: agent task memory cleanup periodically cleans completed task
item: Agent Task Memory Cleanup: Periodically cleans up completed task records and expired team member session references, fixing memory leaks in long-running scenarios

sig: rewind phantom diff fixed the issue where rewind
item: Rewind phantom diff: Fixed the issue where rewind after compact showed non-existent file changes; compact messages now correctly inherit file snapshot state

sig: venus endpoint compatibility adapter support prompt cache injection
item: Venus Endpoint Compatibility Adapter: Support Prompt cache injection and request field sanitization for Venus OpenAI-compatible proxy endpoints; model adapters and endpoint adapters can be stacked

sig: agent recovery after compact fixed the issue where
item: Agent Recovery After Compact: Fixed the issue where the session incorrectly used the compact agent after context compression, ensuring subsequent conversations resume normally

sig: long conversation recovery improved stability automatic recovery after
item: Long Conversation Recovery: Improved stability of automatic recovery after context overflow, reducing context handling anomalies during error retries; refined pre-message compaction behavior in long sessions so the current input is no longer unexpectedly interrupted when compaction fails

sig: internal generator agent optimization internal task agents context
item: Internal Generator Agent Optimization: Internal-task agents (context compaction, title generation, summary generation, etc.) no longer auto-inject the SendMessage tool, saving prompt tokens and avoiding pollution of structured output.

sig: trace visualization web tracesview adds new metrics including
item: Trace Visualization: Web UI TracesView adds new metrics including LLM call statistics, cache hit rate, and multi-model display

sig: app server integrations can now read account token
item: App-server integrations can now read account token usage, and Codex auth supports v2 personal access tokens in CLI and app-server flows. (#25344, #25731)

sig: added tui and app server controls for memory
item: Added TUI and app-server controls for memory mode, memory reset/deletion, and memory-extension cleanup (#17632, #17626, #17913, #17937, #17844).

sig: memories are now configurable and there new codex
item: Memories are now configurable, and there is a new codex debug clear-memories command to fully reset saved memory state when needed. (#12997, #12999, #13002, #13085)

sig: added thread compact the app server api async
item: Added thread/compact to the v2 app-server API as an async trigger RPC, so clients can start compaction immediately and track completion separately.

sig: observability increases command items expose process ids and
item: Observability increases as command items expose process IDs and threads and turns emit token-usage and compaction events. Feedback metadata captures source information.

sig: native compaction support added first class support for
item: Native Compaction Support: added first-class support for Compaction, improving performance across extended coding sessions.

sig: crush has size limit certain operations avoid the
item: Crush has a size limit on certain operations to avoid the whole context window getting filled up rendering a session useless. There were some bugs around this which we fixed, tool-to-tool. So now, if your project is a single huge index.php, file Crush should be able to work it out just fine.

sig: image heavy sessions longer invalidate the provider prompt
item: Image-heavy sessions no longer invalidate the provider prompt cache on every request once the trailing-image cap is reached; older images are evicted in batches, reducing token costs and latency in long sessions.

sig: cheaper self improvement smarter background review the post
item: Cheaper self-improvement — smarter background review — The post-turn self-improvement fork (the one that decides whether to save a memory or skill) now routes to an auxiliary model, digests context instead of replaying the whole conversation, and adapts its cadence — so the "learn from what just happened" loop that runs after your turns costs a fraction of what it used to. You keep the self-improvement, you stop paying full main-model price for it. (#49252 — @teknium1)

sig: steer mid run agent nudges steer prompt injects
item: /steer — mid-run agent nudges — /steer <prompt> injects a note that the running agent sees after its next tool call, without interrupting the turn or breaking prompt cache. For when you want to course-correct an agent in-flight.

sig: hermes backup hermes import full backup and restore
item: hermes backup & hermes import — Full backup and restore of your Hermes configuration, sessions, skills, and memory. Migrate between machines or create snapshots before major changes.

sig: memory security reject prompt like text submitted through
item: Memory/security: reject prompt-like text submitted through the explicit memory_store tool before embedding or storage, matching the existing auto-capture prompt-injection filter.

sig: reply perf reduce visible reply delivery latency preserving
item: Reply/perf: reduce visible reply delivery latency by preserving Telegram typing/progress context, lazy-loading slash-command startup metadata, avoiding hot-path model hydration, flag-gating Codex profiler timing, deferring context compaction maintenance, and tracking delivery timing. (#86989, #86990, #86991, #86992, #86993, #86994) Thanks @keshavbotagent.

sig: memory wiki keep wiki_lint tool output path safe
item: Memory Wiki: keep wiki_lint tool output path-safe by reporting vault-internal lint reports as relative paths in tool text and details while preserving absolute report paths for CLI/file callers. (#83439) Thanks @LLagoon3.

sig: agents codex use the codex runtime context window
item: Agents/Codex: use the Codex runtime context window for OpenAI-model preflight compaction and memory flush checks, so GPT-5.5 Codex sessions compact before hitting the smaller native context limit. Fixes #82982. Thanks @vliuyt.

sig: system prompts clarify memory guidance over generic tts
item: System prompts: clarify MEMORY guidance over generic TTS hints in the embedded speech-core/system-prompt scaffolding so agents prefer memory-store usage over speech defaults. Fixes #81930. Thanks @giodl73-repo.

sig: memory daily files widen the daily memory file
item: Memory/daily-files: widen the daily-memory file matcher used by Dreaming, rem-backfill, rem-harness, the doctor sweep, and short-term promotion so memory/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md files written by the bundled session-memory hook (and any future slugged variants) are discovered alongside the date-only memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md shape. Date extraction still uses the leading YYYY-MM-DD capture group, so per-day ingestion/promotion semantics are unchanged for existing date-only files; slugged files now flow through the same paths instead of being silently skipped. Fixes #69536. Thanks @jack-stormentswe.

sig: agents tool result guard use the resolved runtime
item: Agents/tool-result guard: use the resolved runtime context token budget for non-context-engine tool-result overflow checks, so long tool-heavy sessions no longer compact early when contextTokens is larger than native contextWindow. Fixes #74917. Thanks @kAIborg24.

sig: agents compaction add opt agents defaults compaction maxactivetranscriptbytes
item: Agents/compaction: add an opt-in agents.defaults.compaction.maxActiveTranscriptBytes preflight trigger that runs normal local compaction when the active JSONL grows too large, requiring transcript rotation so successful compaction moves future turns onto a smaller successor file instead of raw byte-splitting history. Thanks @vincentkoc.

sig: control refine the agent tool access panel with
item: Control UI: refine the agent Tool Access panel with compact live-tool chips, collapsible tool groups, direct per-tool toggles, and clearer runtime/source provenance. (#71405) Thanks @BunsDev.

sig: agents context engines preserve prompt only token counts
item: Agents/context engines: preserve prompt-only token counts, not full request totals, when deferred maintenance reuses after-turn runtime context so background compaction bookkeeping matches the active prompt window. (#66820) thanks @jalehman.

sig: memory active memory keep recall runs the resolved
item: Memory/active-memory: keep recall runs on the resolved channel when wrappers like mx-claw are enabled, improve lexical fallback ranking, and keep lexical boosts out of hybrid search so recall finds the right memories more consistently. (#65049, #65395) Thanks @Takhoffman.

sig: memory qmd stop registering the legacy lowercase root
item: Memory/QMD: stop registering the legacy lowercase root memory file as a separate default collection, so QMD now prefers MEMORY.md and the memory/ tree without duplicate collection-add warnings.

sig: memory plugins move the pre compaction memory flush
item: Memory/plugins: move the pre-compaction memory flush plan behind the active memory plugin contract so memory-core owns flush prompts and target-path policy instead of hardcoded core logic.

sig: hooks compaction lifecycle emit session compact before and
item: Hooks/Compaction lifecycle: emit session:compact:before and session:compact:after internal events plus plugin compaction callbacks with session/count metadata, so automations can react to compaction runs consistently. (#16788) thanks @vincentkoc.

sig: agents compaction post context configurability add agents defaults
item: Agents/compaction post-context configurability: add agents.defaults.compaction.postCompactionSections so deployments can choose which AGENTS.md sections are re-injected after compaction, while preserving legacy fallback behavior when the documented default pair is configured in any order. (#34556) thanks @efe-arv.

sig: agents compaction cancel safeguard compaction when summary generation
item: Agents/Compaction: cancel safeguard compaction when summary generation cannot run (missing model/API key or summarization failure), preserving history instead of truncating to fallback "Summary unavailable" text. (#10711) Thanks @DukeDeSouth and @vincentkoc.

sig: memory builtin prevent automatic sync races with manager
item: Memory/Builtin: prevent automatic sync races with manager shutdown by skipping post-close sync starts and waiting for in-flight sync before closing SQLite, so onSearch/onSessionStart no longer fail with database is not open in ephemeral CLI flows. (#20556, #7464) Thanks @FuzzyTG and @henrybottter.

sig: agents add safety timeout around embedded session compact
item: Agents: add a safety timeout around embedded session.compact() to ensure stalled compaction runs settle and release blocked session lanes. (#16331) Thanks @BinHPdev.

sig: agents classify external timeout aborts during compaction the
item: Agents: classify external timeout aborts during compaction the same as internal timeouts, preventing unnecessary auth-profile rotation and preserving compaction-timeout snapshot fallback behavior. (#9855) Thanks @mverrilli.

sig: memory prevent cli hangs deferring vector probes add
item: Memory: prevent CLI hangs by deferring vector probes, add sqlite-vec/embedding timeouts, and make session memory indexing async.

sig: memory new clawdbot memory cli plus memory_search memory_get
item: Memory: new clawdbot memory CLI plus memory_search/memory_get tools with snippets + line ranges; index stored under ~/.clawdbot/memory/{agentId}.sqlite with watch-on-by-default.

sig: ensure compaction more reliable adding reserve token buffer
item: Ensure compaction is more reliable by adding reserve token buffer to provide enough room for input window compaction

sig: added transcript usage notices for compaction and branch
item: Added transcript usage notices for compaction and branch summaries when cache miss notices are enabled.

sig: anthropic gateway bearer auth anthropic_auth_token authenticates against anthropic
item: Anthropic gateway bearer auth — ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN authenticates against Anthropic-compatible gateways that require Authorization: Bearer, including compaction and branch summaries. See Environment Variables or Auth File.

sig: mistral prompt caching mistral sessions now use provider
item: Mistral prompt caching - Mistral sessions now use provider-side prompt caching with session affinity and cached-token usage/cost accounting. See API Keys and Environment Variables.

sig: fixed agentsession retry compaction and event settlement use
item: Fixed AgentSession retry, compaction, and event settlement to use the awaited agent lifecycle instead of a separate event queue, and added willRetry to agent_end session events.

sig: navigatetree now supports replaceinstructions option replace the default
item: navigateTree() now supports replaceInstructions option to replace the default summarization prompt entirely, and label option to attach a label to the branch summary entry (#787 by @mitsuhiko)

sig: unified settings command new settings menu consolidating thinking
item: Unified /settings command: New settings menu consolidating thinking level, theme, queue mode, auto-compact, show images, hide thinking, and collapse changelog. Replaces individual /thinking, /queue, /theme, /autocompact, and /show-images commands.

sig: context compaction long sessions can now compacted reduce
item: Context Compaction: Long sessions can now be compacted to reduce context usage while preserving recent conversation history. (#92, docs)

sig: added web preview panels with desktop and mobile
item: Added Web preview panels with desktop and mobile widths, refresh, external opening, saved HTML artifacts, and per-session URL and width memory. (#11276) by @wenshao

sig: operators can now configure disable the goal token
item: Operators can now configure or disable the Goal token budget using the model.goalTokenBudget setting, with support for values from 1 to 300,000,000 or -1 for unlimited. (#10543) by @qqqys

sig: enabled chat compression reuse the main conversation prompt
item: Enabled chat compression to reuse the main conversation prompt cache when using supported providers, reducing latency without executing tools. (#8339) by @DragonnZhang

sig: added the compaction flag the model command configure
item: Added the --compaction flag to the /model command to configure a dedicated model for chat compression. (#7818) by @Aleks-0

sig: swe agent enigma enhanced interactive generative model agent
item: SWE-agent EnIGMA (Enhanced Interactive Generative Model Agent) is SOTA on offensive cybersecurity challenges, with a 3.3x improvement over previous agents on the NYU CTF challenge dataset. The EnIGMA project introduces multiple novelties that are available to all use cases of SWE-agent, such as Interactive Agent Tools and a Summarizer to handle long outputs.

sig: agent made token usage display consistent between the
item: Agent: Made token usage display consistent between the models that support displaying split usage (input and output) and those that don't.

sig: agent added the ability regenerate the auto summarized
item: Agent: Added the ability to regenerate the auto-summarized title of threads via the "Regenerate Thread Title" button, available in the ellipsis menu of the agent panel. (#43859; thanks aeroxy)

sig: added support for new gemini models including gemini
item: Added support for new Gemini models including gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 with thinking tokens support.

sig: dropped the configured checkmark from the composer provider
item: Dropped the "Configured" checkmark from the composer's provider picker (added in 0.0.25). Every row in that picker has a saved settings entry, so for anyone who set their providers up in the app every row carried the same green check and it read as decoration. Settings is still where provider readiness is shown, and it distinguishes a real credential from an entry a legacy migration left behind

sig: chatgpt subscription codex now lists only the models
item: ChatGPT Subscription (Codex) now lists only the models your plan can actually use. Two separate paths filled the picker from the shared OpenAI catalog, so GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and chatgpt-image-latest showed up alongside the Codex models, and the runtime lost the Codex context caps. The model rules also match what the backend now accepts: gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini were retired for ChatGPT accounts on 2026-08-31 and are gone, the default moves to gpt-5.6-terra, and every Codex model is capped at the real 400K/272K/128K backend budget instead of inheriting the API's 1.05M limits

sig: fixed tool calling being silently disabled for gateway
item: Fixed tool calling being silently disabled for gateway models whose catalog entry declares no capabilities. Three separate producers built gateway model definitions with their own hand-written capability translations and had drifted; the builtin-provider path emitted ["text"] where the others emitted undefined, and that list read as an authoritative denial that stripped every tool definition from requests to Dify, SAP AI Core, opencode, and the Codex CLI. One shared translator now serves every producer

sig: sdk telemetry spans now carry user session conversation
item: AI SDK telemetry spans now carry user, session, conversation, run, provider, and model context under a stable cline-sdk service name

sig: show the full model catalog for every vertex
item: Show the full model catalog for every Vertex region instead of filtering the picker down to a hardcoded list of global-endpoint models, which lagged behind every model launch. Picking a model the region doesn't serve now fails at request time with recovery guidance in the error row.

sig: reasoning settings now resolve portably across sdk providers
item: Reasoning settings now resolve portably across AI SDK providers — effort levels and enable/disable flags map to the AI SDK's native reasoning setting (including Ollama), replacing the per-provider thinking overrides, and an explicit request to disable reasoning now takes priority

sig: added cline api key path onboarding and you
item: Added a Cline API key path to onboarding, and you can now cancel a pending browser sign-in instead of being stuck waiting for it.

sig: cline now uses anthropic new computer use feature
item: Cline now uses Anthropic's new "Computer Use" feature to launch a browser, click, type, and scroll. This gives him more autonomy in runtime debugging, end-to-end testing, and even general web use. Try asking "look up the weather in Colorado" to see it in action! (Available with Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2)

sig: claude changes now appear your file timeline allowing
item: Claude's changes now appear in your file's Timeline, allowing you to easily view a diff of each edit. This is especially helpful if you want to revert to a previous version. No need for git—everything is tracked by VSCode's local history!

sig: refined model switch configuration each model independently declares
item: Refined Model Switch Configuration: Each model independently declares relatedModels.lite / relatedModels.reasoning, removing the global fallback that no longer covered new model scenarios, ensuring each model jumps to the expected target model when switching between lite / reasoning.

sig: custom model temperature can left empty when custom
item: Custom model Temperature can be left empty: When a custom model has no Temperature configured, the field is no longer sent upstream, preventing GPT-5 and other OpenAI-compatible models that do not support or only support the default value from returning 400. In the Web UI, Temperature is now an optional numeric input field that can be left blank.

sig: api key configuration support configuring api key through
item: API Key Configuration: Support configuring API Key through settings, providing more flexible authentication options

sig: new model support added gpt model configuration
item: New Model Support: Added GPT-5.3-Codex model configuration

sig: model compatibility layer added model compatibility handler that
item: Model compatibility layer: Added a model compatibility handler that automatically adapts API request format differences for third-party models such as Gemini and Moonshot, reducing manual configuration

sig: enhanced model compatibility added openai model adapter automatically
item: Enhanced Model Compatibility: Added an OpenAI model adapter to automatically handle incompatible parameters; the Gemini adapter now includes JSON Schema field cleanup, fixing 400 errors caused by tool parameters

sig: thinking mode now globally enabled default providing enhanced
item: Thinking mode is now globally enabled by default, providing enhanced reasoning capabilities without manual configuration. Complex code analysis and multi-step task processing are now more accurate.

sig: added support for configuring gpt astra through the
item: Added support for configuring GPT-6-Astra through the API without changing the default model or showing it in the model picker.

sig: the python sdk now supports first class authentication
item: The Python SDK now supports first-class authentication, including API key login, ChatGPT browser and device-code flows, account inspection, and logout APIs.

sig: you want skip cost calculation for given provider
item: If you want to skip cost calculation for a given provider, you can now set it as a flat rate provider on your crush.json. This is useful when using subscription, where the cost is theorically zero as you're not really paying per token.

sig: this release adds support for the new openai
item: This release adds support for the new OpenAI models, GPT-5.4 Mini and Nano, released just today. GPT-5.4 Nano is also the new default small model for OpenAI.

sig: ordered fallback provider chain configure multiple inference providers
item: Ordered Fallback Provider Chain — Configure multiple inference providers with automatic failover. When your primary provider returns errors or is unreachable, Hermes automatically tries the next provider in the chain. Configure via fallback_providers in config.yaml. (#3813, closes #1734)

sig: agent and fallback behavior aborted runs stop cleanly

(#94412, #95218, #95508, #95420, #95418, #95417, #95400) Thanks @szsip239, @vincentkoc, @Alix-007, @mikasa0818, @sallyom, @riazrahaman, and @jason-allen-oneal.

sig: kimi code support the provider catalog now includes
item: Kimi K2.7 Code support: the provider catalog now includes the new Kimi coding model, with replay handling that preserves its reasoning content across tool turns. (#92554, #92396) Thanks @xialonglee and @RoseKongPS.

sig: parallel web search bundled api key discovery guarded

sig: agents media accept generated media attachments internal completion
item: Agents/media: accept generated media attachments on internal completion events and report delivery-loss failures as errors, so completed background music/video tasks do not disappear after provider success.

sig: agents runtime apply agents defaults models provider agentruntime
item: Agents/runtime: apply agents.defaults.models["provider/*"].agentRuntime as provider-wide model runtime policy while preserving exact model runtime precedence. Fixes #82243. Thanks @rendrag-git.

sig: codex harness keep auth profile backed media tools
item: Codex harness: keep auth-profile-backed media tools such as image_generate available when OpenAI auth lives in the agent's auth-profile store instead of environment variables.

sig: voice ollama honor routed voice agent tools allow
item: Voice/Ollama: honor routed voice agent tools.allow for classic embedded voice responses, including empty allowlists, so no-tool Ollama agents do not receive tool schemas. Fixes #79506. Thanks @donkeykong91.

sig: agents apply the llm idle watchdog while provider
item: Agents: apply the LLM idle watchdog while provider stream setup is still pending, preventing silent pre-stream model hangs from waiting for the full agent timeout.

sig: agents models forward model maxtokens the default output
item: Agents/models: forward model maxTokens as the default output-token limit for OpenAI-compatible Responses and Completions transports when no runtime override is provided, preventing provider defaults from silently truncating larger outputs. (#76645) Thanks @joeyfrasier.

sig: models suppress explicitly configured openai codex gpt inline
item: Models: suppress explicitly configured openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini inline entries so a stale models config written by openclaw doctor --fix cannot bypass the manifest capability block and cause repeated assistant-turn failures when the runtime switches to that model on ChatGPT-backed Codex accounts. sig: discord persist routed model picker overrides when the
item: Discord: persist routed model-picker overrides when the hidden /model dispatch succeeds but the bound thread session store is still stale, including LM Studio suffixed model ids. Carries forward #61473. Thanks @Nanako0129.

sig: security plugins keep web search credential presence checks

sig: providers google add gemini live realtime voice provider

sig: image generation let agents request provider supported quality

sig: thinking only expose max for models that explicitly

sig: telegram model picker make inline model button selections

item: Added full openRouterRouting field support in models.json, including fallbacks, parameter requirements, data collection, ZDR, ignore lists, quantizations, provider sorting, max price, and preferred throughput and latency constraints (#2904 by @zmberber)

item: Add support for Claude Code Provider native tool calling, improving tool execution performance and reliability (PR #10077 by @hannesrudolph)

item: Enable native tools by default for Anthropic and add telemetry tracking for tool format usage (PR #10021 by @daniel-lxs)

sig: new adaptive model option now available the model

sig: introduced new model picker that groups models family
item: We introduced a new model picker that groups models by family and adds a hovercard with toggles for

sig: gpt and gpt are now available windsurf gpt
item: GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.1-Codex are now available in Windsurf. GPT-5.1 will become the default model in Windsurf for one week, and paid users get free access during this period.GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.1-Codex deliver a solid upgrade from GPT-5 for agentic coding workflows. They’re noticeably better at understanding what you’re asking for and working with you to get it done. The new variable thinking feature dynamically adjusts reasoning depth—providing quick responses for simple tasks and more thoughtful analysis when complexity demands it.

sig: this week release includes support for parallel subagents
item: This week's release includes support for parallel subagents, Vercel AI Gateway as a new LLM provider, git diff stats in the git panel, and support for compound emojis.

sig: fixed commit message button git panel being hidden
item: Fixed AI commit message button in Git panel being hidden instead of disabled when no AI provider is configured. The button now remains visible with a tooltip explaining how to enable the feature. (#46525; thanks ivan-magda)

sig: agent added support for authenticating amazon bedrock with
item: Agent: Added support for authenticating Amazon Bedrock with API keys (bearer tokens), including via environment variable or the UI. (#41393; thanks 5herlocked)

sig: macos improved pasting inserting the actual file path
item: macOS: Improved pasting by inserting the actual file path when the clipboard contains a file URL (enables image paste support for Claude Code). (#36848; thanks seantimm)

sig: this preview bit quiet due preparation for the

sig: last week launched agent client protocol acp open
item: Last week we launched Agent Client Protocol (ACP), an open standard for integrating external agents with editors. Today we're launching beta support for Claude Code in Zed via our ACP adapter for the Claude Code SDK! Read more about it in the blog post.

sig: agent fixed issue where clicking start new thread
item: Agent: Fixed an issue where clicking on "Start New Thread" in the agent configuration would not always switch to the correct provider/model.

sig: added support for prompt caching anthropic for models
item: Added support for Prompt Caching in Anthropic. For models that support it this can dramatically lower cost while improving performance (#16274; thanks rowillia).

sig: adds support for prompt caching anthropic for models
item: Adds support for Prompt Caching in Anthropic.  For models that support it this can dramatically lower cost while improving performance (#16274; thanks rowillia).

sig: sub agent session resume support resuming previous sub
item: Sub-agent Session Resume: Support resuming previous sub-task sessions based on existing context, suitable for staged analysis and iterative optimization scenarios

sig: added the codebuddy agents json command the list

sig: call other agents agent cli can now act
item: Call other Agents: Agent CLI can now act as a standard A2A (Agent2Agent) client to discover and invoke other authorized Agents. Delegate tasks with @Agent or natural language, invoke multiple Agents in parallel, and see intermediate status updates in real time without repeatedly polling manually.

sig: a2a protocol alignment and experience the list delegatable
item: A2A protocol alignment and experience: The list of delegatable Agents is rendered in real time from discovery results, and Agent Cards are retrieved by exact name. Canceling a remote task now actually notifies the remote endpoint to stop, preventing it from continuing to consume compute resources.

sig: custom agent model fields plugins now take effect
item: Custom agent model fields in plugins now take effect: Fixed an issue where the model field in agent frontmatter under plugin directories was ignored. Custom models declared by plugin authors are now actually used for subagent execution.

sig: real time multitask progress web workbuddy can now
item: Real-time Multitask progress: Web / WorkBuddy can now display tool calls, results, and final responses from background workers dispatched by the coordinator in real time. After a worker finishes, the host receives a new conversation-turn notification.

sig: tool permission isolation optimized subagent tool permission management
item: Tool Permission Isolation: Optimized subagent tool permission management, ensuring each agent receives correct tool access permissions

sig: the task tool now supports model parameter for
item: The Task tool now supports a model parameter for specifying model variants like lite and reasoning. You can choose the appropriate model based on task complexity:

sig: custom sub agent tool inheritance fixed issue where
item: Custom Sub-agent Tool Inheritance: Fixed an issue where custom sub-agents would inherit the ability to create sub-agents when no tool list was configured, preventing unintended recursive calls

sig: team members now support three runtime backends process
item: Team members now support three runtime backends: in-process (default), detached-process, and tmux visualization. Switch flexibly via the --swarm parameter or environment variables to meet collaboration needs across different scenarios.

sig: built commit and commit push commands used for
item: Built-in /commit and /commit-push-pr Commands: Used for internal delegation by the main agent to standardize Git commit and PR flows; not visible in the / menu for users

sig: added hook events covering tool failures sub agent
item: Added 20+ hook events covering tool failures, sub-agent lifecycle, task management, permission approvals, file watching, and more:

sig: guardian review history survives compaction restarts and user
item: Guardian review history survives compaction, restarts, and user-created forks while respecting rollback boundaries and isolating subagent history. (#41879, #42065)

sig: feat profiles add built verifier profile for subagent
item: feat(profiles): add built-in verifier profile for subagent review/validation (84d3a1aa9)

sig: background async subagents delegate work and keep going
item: Background / async subagents — delegate work and keep going — delegate_task(background=true) now dispatches a subagent that runs in the background and returns a handle immediately. You and the model keep working while it churns, and the full result re-enters the conversation as a new turn the moment it finishes. Kick off a long research dive or a multi-step build, then carry on with something else instead of sitting blocked waiting on it. (#40946, #46968 — @teknium1)

sig: centralized provider router rebuilt provider system with call_llm
item: Centralized Provider Router — Rebuilt provider system with call_llm API, unified /model command, auto-detect provider on model switch, and direct endpoint overrides for auxiliary/delegation clients. (#1003, #1506, #1375)

sig: persistent sessions and subagent runs keep persistent sessions
item: Persistent sessions and subagent runs: keep persistent sessions created with visible spawning editable and steerable in their parent tree. Subagent runs remain view-only, omit author avatars, and keep live progress in the parent conversation with inactive cards paused. (#139367, #139371, #139381, #139456, #141499)

sig: tui fuzzy selectors delegate list matching tui adding
item: TUI fuzzy selectors: delegate list matching to pi-tui, adding slash-token and alpha-number matching while removing the local matcher fork.

sig: more reliable install update release paths alpine installs
item: More reliable install/update/release paths: Alpine installs, trusted runtime fallback roots, stable update channels, Docker/package timeouts, Windows Scheduled Tasks, Windows/macOS proof lanes, Testbox/Crabbox delegation, plugin publish checks, and macOS runner bootstraps all got hardened.

sig: more reliable replay and installs legacy tool results
item: More reliable replay and installs: legacy tool results, subagent spawn payloads, stale lock ownership, Windows stack-heavy startup, macOS restart validation, and Docker package preparation all fail less surprisingly.

sig: cli tasks include stale running task maintenance decisions
item: CLI/tasks: include stale-running task maintenance decisions in openclaw tasks maintenance --json so retained and reconcile candidates explain backing-session, cron, CLI, and wedged-subagent state. (#84691) Thanks @efpiva.

sig: agents and subagents queued follow ups manual turn
item: Agents and subagents: queued follow-ups, manual-turn priority, subagent completion handoffs, session locks, context usage, fallback diagnostics, and final payload delivery were made more predictable.

sig: microsoft teams add reaction support reaction listing graph
item: Microsoft Teams: add reaction support, reaction listing, Graph pagination, and delegated OAuth setup for sending reactions while preserving application-auth read paths.

sig: gateway subagent tls pairing allow authenticated local gateway
item: Gateway/Subagent TLS pairing: allow authenticated local gateway-client backend self-connections to skip device pairing while still requiring pairing for non-local/direct-host paths, restoring sessions_spawn with gateway.tls.enabled=true in Docker/LAN setups. Fixes #30740. Thanks @Sid-Qin and @vincentkoc.

sig: agents subagents delivery refactor subagent completion announce dispatch
item: Agents/Subagents delivery: refactor subagent completion announce dispatch into an explicit queue/direct/fallback state machine, recover outbound channel-plugin resolution in cold/stale plugin-registry states across announce/message/gateway send paths, finalize cleanup bookkeeping when announce flow rejects, and treat Telegram sends without message_id as delivery failures (instead of false-success "unknown" IDs). (#26867, #25961, #26803, #25069, #26741) Thanks @SmithLabsLLC and @docaohieu2808.

sig: agents strengthen memory recall guidance make workspace bootstrap

sig: agent eval fixes llm config issue for delegation
item: [Agent, Eval] Fixes LLM config issue for delegation & Add eval to measure the delegation accuracy

sig: adds the qwen review emit workflow subcommand generate
item: Adds the qwen review emit-workflow subcommand to generate a deterministic script that executes Review Step 3A's agent fan-out using parallel() instead of manual orchestration. (#10119) by @qqqys

sig: permission rules from different levels enterprise mode user
item: Permission rules from different levels (enterprise, mode, user, project, subagent) now compose predictably — an explicit deny: always wins, “always allow” options only appear when the grant would actually take effect, and denials say which layer denied them.

sig: fast context introduced fast context subagent powered swe
item: Fast Context: Introduced Fast Context subagent powered by SWE-grep, enabling agents to find relevant code context up to 20x faster with >2,800 tokens per second throughput.

sig: update edit format the new model default when
item: Update edit format to the new model's default when switching models with /model, if the user was using the old model's default format.

sig: cline longer stops silently mid task when model
item: Cline no longer stops silently mid-task when a model gets stuck repeating itself. The loop detector stops a run after 5 identical tool calls and the mistake tracker after 6 consecutive failures, but the desktop never registered a decision callback, so the run just ended and the composer went idle with no message. You are now asked how to continue — "Try a different approach" or "Stop this run" — and the guidance is steered into the running turn so the model knows why it was paused instead of repeating the same call

sig: hooks now resolve their workspace from the code
item: Hooks now resolve their workspace from the VS Code window instead of shared global state in ~/.cline. With a second window open on another project, a workspace's .clinerules/hooks scripts were never discovered, and hook cwd and the workspace paths passed to hook scripts resolved against whatever project some other or older Cline instance last recorded.

sig: automatic updates the app checks launch and every
item: Automatic updates: the app checks on launch and every 2 hours, downloads new versions in the background, and prompts for a one-click restart. Ignored updates apply on the next launch.

sig: add edit and regenerate support for previous user
item: Add edit-and-regenerate support for previous user messages, with clearer Reset Chat and Reset Code actions.

sig: add ability allow the user type their next
item: Add ability to allow the user to type their next message into the chat while Cline is taking action

sig: added e2e test coverage for the prompt type
item: Added E2E test coverage for the prompt-type Stop hook lifecycle and robustness validation, ensuring correct Stop hook behavior when triggered by prompt events.

sig: sharelink can now directly share markdown files with
item: ShareLink can now directly share .md / .markdown files, with the page rendered server-side into a styled result. Support for .htm has also been added. Key enhancements:

sig: added the source fields needed for otel gen_ai
item: Added the source fields needed for OTEL gen_ai semantic mapping, integrated with AgentLens via the OTEL_SEMCONV=agentlens switch, and improved model/usage attributes and trace finalization information on the model call chain. Pure attribute additions; no changes to existing conversation and tool execution behavior.

sig: cleaned buildsystemprompt built tool snippets and tool local
item: Cleaned up buildSystemPrompt() so built-in tool snippets and tool-local guidelines come from built-in ToolDefinition metadata, while cross-tool and global prompt rules stay in system prompt construction.

sig: prevented the triage agent from processing tracking issues

sig: added support for comment language injections for remaining

sig: turns that come back completely empty are now

Tool-call-only turns are never retried, and turns that error or hit the token limit pass through unchanged

sig: macos sandbox file backup backup pipeline integrated before

sig: improved command pagination local and sandbox commands now

sig: completing legacy workbuddy sandbox configuration fixed legacy sandbox

sig: browser cdp startup diagnostics include chrome stderr output

sig: introduces primitives for standalone conversation isolation enabling deterministic

sig: session forked from checkpoint restore longer comes back
item: A session forked from a checkpoint restore no longer comes back stuck on "Thinking...". Sessions that materialize with seeded history never passed their status when persisting, so the row and manifest were written as "running" while the live session was idle; resuming from that manifest then showed a session that was never going to finish

sig: restoring checkpoint now refuses run when head has
item: Restoring a checkpoint now refuses to run when HEAD has moved past the commit the checkpoint was taken on. The restore's git reset --hard silently knocked any later commits off the branch, leaving them reachable only through the reflog; the branch move is now a compare-and-swap so a commit landing mid-restore cannot be lost either

sig: the hub durable event log now capped mib
item: The hub's durable event log is now capped at 64 MiB on disk. Event envelopes carrying full session snapshots could previously accumulate to tens of gigabytes, since row and time retention alone did not bound file size and deletes never shrink a SQLite file. Oldest events are dropped first and the file is vacuumed to return the space, and pruning now also runs after every 16 MiB appended instead of waiting for the hourly sweep

sig: includes the main updates the redesigned first run

sig: stop the legacy task migration backlog from spamming
item: Stop the legacy-task migration backlog from spamming telemetry, and record a migration outcome only once the seeded session actually persists, so a failed migration is no longer reported as a success.

sig: undo works again once the agent has used

sig: fix regression introduced where the interactive cli could
item: Fix a regression introduced in 3.0.15 where the interactive CLI could get stuck after stopping and restarting Cline Hub and then pressing Escape to cancel a request. item: Empty Model Response Handling: Fixed an issue where a model that finished normally but returned no valid content would cause the conversation to be silently cancelled, with only a placeholder shown in the UI. sig: added access the local shell environment for task

sig: signing out chatgpt codex now sticks sign out
item: Signing out of ChatGPT (Codex) now sticks. Sign-out removes the provider entry, but the runtime re-imports any missing provider from the classic extension's stored credentials on every command, so the next action signed you straight back in. The legacy Codex credentials are now cleared too, and a failed clear reports the sign-out as failed instead of quietly succeeding

sig: roll the stable code extension back the pre

sig: settings write loss fixed issue where writing config

sig: skill agent file parsing fixed descriptions being lost

sig: security exec approvals escape invisible unicode format characters

sig: feishu doc permissions support optional owner permission grant

sig: feishu permission error dispatch merge sender name permission

sig: gateway models honor explicit agents defaults models allowlist

sig: add support for uploading various file types xml

sig: cli parameter support use the text image model
item: CLI Parameter Support: Use the --text-to-image-model parameter at startup to specify the default model

sig: wecom group bot image text combined sending when

sig: manually constructed late joining turn handles receive events
item: Manually constructed or late-joining turn handles receive events from their attachment point. Earlier output is not replayed, so collected results can be partial; attaching after completion can raise TransportClosedError. Use thread.read(include_turns=True) for saved history. Handles returned directly by thread.turn(...) retain events from when their request is sent.

sig: local image attachments and standalone image generations now
item: Local image attachments and standalone image generations now expose their saved file paths to the model, which makes follow-up edits and file references more reliable. (#25944, #25947)

sig: the tool gateway release paid nous portal subscribers
item: The Tool Gateway release — paid Nous Portal subscribers can now use web search, image generation, text-to-speech, and browser automation through their existing subscription with zero additional API keys.

sig: macos app streamlined native chat composer browser sidebar
item: macOS app: a streamlined native chat composer, a browser sidebar that can expand past half width, lower idle menu-bar CPU, notifications when background sessions finish, a Talk overlay that survives quick toggles, and speech recognizers reused between voice captures. Related #136157, #136562, #127645. (#135608, #136168, #136572, #136519, #135731, #135401) Thanks @HuzaifaChaudary and @Colton-Harris.

sig: agents media keep async image music and video

sig: deepinfra load the full model catalog when users

sig: voice expose shared realtime turn context tracking through
item: Voice: expose shared realtime turn-context tracking through the realtime voice SDK and reuse it for Discord speaker attribution and wake-name context recovery.

sig: imessage thread current channel account inbound attachment roots
item: iMessage: thread current channel/account inbound attachment roots into the image tool so iMessage-saved attachments under ~/Library/Messages/Attachments (including wildcard roots) are read through the existing inbound path policy instead of being rejected as path-not-allowed. Fixes #30170.

sig: discord voice add realtime wake name gating with
item: Discord/voice: add realtime wake-name gating with agent-name defaults and raise profile bootstrap context budget for longer USER.md/SOUL.md files.

sig: gateway media prevent image filenames from overriding generic

sig: discord voice add voice allowedchannels restrict voice joins
item: Discord/voice: add voice.allowedChannels to restrict voice joins and bot voice-state moves to configured channels while preserving open voice behavior when unset.

sig: discord voice make voice capture less choppy extending
item: Discord/voice: make voice capture less choppy by extending the default post-speech silence grace to 2.5s, add voice.captureSilenceGraceMs for noisy Discord sessions, and tighten the spoken-output prompt around live STT fragments. Thanks @vincentkoc.

sig: agents generated media treat attachment style message tool
item: Agents/generated media: treat attachment-style message tool actions as completed chat sends, preventing duplicate fallback media posts when generated files were already uploaded.

sig: pdf extraction resolve pdf standard fonts from the

Fixes #51455; carries forward #70936, #54447, and #62175. Thanks @anyech, @JuanRdBO, and @solomonneas.

sig: discord allow channels discord voice model override the

sig: gateway webchat preserve image attachments for text only
item: Gateway/WebChat: preserve image attachments for text-only primary models by offloading them as media refs instead of dropping them, so configured image tools can still inspect the original file. Fixes #68513, #44276, #51656, #70212.

sig: discord inbound media pass discord attachment and sticker
item: Discord/inbound media: pass Discord attachment and sticker downloads through the shared idle-timeout and worker-abort path so slow or stuck inbound media fetches stop hanging message processing. (#58593) Thanks @aquaright1

sig: telegram message tool add asdocument user facing alias

sig: ios app store connect release prep align ios

sig: feishu docx tables uploads add feishu_doc actions for
item: Feishu/Docx tables + uploads: add feishu_doc actions for Docx table creation/cell writing (create_table, write_table_cells, create_table_with_values) and image/file uploads (upload_image, upload_file) with stricter create/upload error handling for missing document_id and placeholder cleanup failures. (#20304) Thanks @xuhao1.

sig: agents image tool propagate the effective workspace root
item: Agents/Image tool: propagate the effective workspace root into tool wiring so workspace-local image paths are accepted by default when running without an explicit workspaceDir.

sig: media fix text attachment mime misclassification with csv
item: Media: fix text attachment MIME misclassification with CSV/TSV inference and UTF-16 detection; add XML attribute escaping for file output. (#3628) Thanks @f...

sig: tts move telegram tts into core enable model
item: TTS: move Telegram TTS into core + enable model-driven TTS tags by default for expressive audio replies. (#1559) Thanks @Glucksberg. https://docs.clawd.bot/tts

sig: gateway api expand responses support file image inputs
