sig: clipboard image paste support via ctrl images are
item: Clipboard image paste support via Ctrl+V. Images are saved to a temp file and attached to the message. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux (X11).

sig: image shifting tool output fixed issue where images
item: Image shifting in tool output: Fixed an issue where images in tool output would shift down (due to accumulating spacers) each time the tool output was expanded or collapsed via Ctrl+O.

sig: enabled microphone access for the macos desktop app
item: Enabled microphone access for the macOS Desktop app by adding the required usage description and audio-input entitlement. (#8715) by @yiliang114

sig: feat add clipboard image support and attachment cli
item: feat: Add clipboard image support and attachment UI to CLI

sig: fixed ability select audio input output devices for
item: Fixed ability to select audio input/output devices for legacy (non-experimental/rodio-enabled) audio.

sig: fix otel telemetry variable bundling telemetry correctly enabled
item: Fix OTEL telemetry variable bundling so telemetry is correctly enabled in compiled CLI builds: guard against environments where process.env is undefined and remove optional chaining so bundlers can inline the values at build time.

sig: added ability retry failed api requests helpful for
item: Added ability to retry failed API requests (helpful for rate limits)

sig: telemetry environment identifier correction fixed issue where the
item: Telemetry Environment Identifier Correction: Fixed an issue where the Desktop sidecar process always reported telemetry with the environment identifier as Production, preventing development-period data from contaminating the formal monitoring database.

sig: ioa endpoint drift defense fixed issue where concurrent
item: IOA Endpoint Drift Defense: Fixed an issue where, in concurrent refresh scenarios, IOA user model requests could briefly fall through to the public cloud domain; internally switched to transactional updates to prevent intermediate states from being read, and added a second line of defense to detect abnormal routing.

sig: glob search tool hanging fixed issue where the
item: Glob search tool hanging: Fixed an issue where the Glob tool could hang permanently in parallel search scenarios. Refactored the underlying search flow's completion determination and timeout control to ensure normal return even when hitting very large directories.

sig: streaming output cancellation handling fixed issue where the
item: Streaming Output Cancellation Handling: Fixed an issue where the result event was misidentified as a retry and suppressed after the user cancelled during compression, preventing non-interactive output and rendering flows from waiting indefinitely for an end signal

sig: wsl1 installation unable run fixed issue where executing
item: WSL1 Installation Unable to Run: Fixed an issue where executing the binary after installation on WSL1 reported Exec format error. The build toolchain has been upgraded to fix this regression — the new binary runs normally on WSL1; meanwhile, install.sh retains WSL1 detection but changes it to a non-blocking warning, no longer directly blocking WSL1 users who can run normally

sig: askuserquestion parameter validation when parameters are invalid instead
item: AskUserQuestion Parameter Validation: When parameters are invalid, instead of silently returning an empty result, a pre-validation step now returns a readable error message, and a rendering fallback is added for question cards.

sig: revert code only option fixed issue where the
item: Revert code only option: Fixed an issue where the "Revert code only" option was incorrectly hidden after the user made changes and then reverted them, preventing rollback to that node. The option is now displayed based on whether file edits occurred in that round.

sig: clearer local hook blocking messages when workspace configured
item: Clearer local hook blocking messages: When a workspace-configured hook is missing or actively blocks execution, it no longer shows a generic "service error." Instead, the conversation now clearly indicates that a local hook intercepted the request along with the reason, aligning with mainstream implementations.

sig: ordering batched taskcreate calls when the model creates
item: Ordering of batched TaskCreate calls: When the model creates tasks concurrently in the same batch, numeric IDs now follow plan order. TaskCreate calls in a batch execute in model call order, while other tools remain concurrent.

sig: built workflows unavailable standalone binaries fixed built workflows
item: Built-in workflows unavailable in standalone binaries: Fixed built-in workflows such as deep-research returning "not found" when invoked from standalone binary installations. Built-in resource discovery and error messages have also been improved

sig: imagegen videogen restored workbuddy fixed issue where these
item: ImageGen / VideoGen restored in WorkBuddy: Fixed an issue where these two tools were mistakenly excluded from the slim WorkBuddy build and therefore never appeared in the available tool list, preventing the model from generating images and videos in craft / plan / expert modes. Whether they are actually enabled after restoration remains controlled by product flags and environment variables.

sig: team member status display fixed issue where team
item: Team Member Status Display: Fixed an issue where team members were incorrectly marked as failed due to the cleanup process after successfully completing tasks. Completed members now correctly display their completion status

sig: settings config file protection fixed issue where write
item: Settings config file protection: Fixed an issue where write operations would overwrite the original file when settings.json contained JSON syntax errors, causing configuration loss. The system now detects corrupted state and prevents overwriting

sig: file lock pid check file locks can now
item: File lock PID check: File locks can now be reclaimed immediately after a process crash, no longer requiring a 5-minute timeout

sig: desktop operation tool visibility desktop operation tools longer
item: Desktop Operation Tool Visibility: Desktop operation tools no longer appear in tool search descriptions when not enabled or on non-macOS platforms, preventing the model from attempting to call them only to be rejected.

sig: ptl context overflow recovery added fallback mechanism that
item: PTL Context Overflow Recovery: Added a fallback mechanism that precisely truncates history by API turn, covering common model error messages

sig: the issue was caused the ide websocket handshake
item: The issue was caused by the IDE WebSocket handshake being incorrectly identified as a regular HTTP response in certain situations, preventing all matching IDEs from connecting. The standalone binary now uses Bun's native WebSocket to bypass the underlying compatibility issue; versions installed via npm continue to use the original implementation and are unaffected.

sig: fix add websocket capability token hash support
item: #17871 fix: add websocket capability token hash support @viyatb-oai

sig: fixed auth error handling for cloud requirements fetch
item: Fixed auth error handling for cloud requirements fetch so 401s trigger the normal auth-recovery messaging instead of a generic workspace-config failure.

sig: fix enable prompt based slash commands edit mode
item: fix: Enable prompt-based slash commands in Edit mode while filtering out built-in legacy commands by @continue[bot]

sig: smart mode and other flag gated features now
item: Smart mode and other flag-gated features now refresh immediately when authentication or team context changes.

sig: hooks are now deduplicated source file hook longer
item: Hooks are now deduplicated by source file, so a hook no longer runs multiple times when the same directory is re-added, workspace directories overlap, or a hook file is reached through a symlink.

sig: failed update recovery restart the managed gateway through
item: Failed-update recovery: restart the managed Gateway through the selected installed CLI after a failed update when the replacement or restored installation is verified usable; retain backups and leave the Gateway stopped when rollback or package readiness remains uncertain. Related #118244. (#119516) Thanks @zyw02, @Issue-Hunter, @cursoragent, and @sercada.

sig: lab hard gate required openclaw dynamic runtime tool
item: QA-Lab: hard-gate required OpenClaw dynamic runtime-tool drift in the standard Codex-vs-Pi tier with a blocking release-check verifier and publish the tool coverage report artifact. Fixes #80339; refs #80319. Thanks @100yenadmin.

sig: agents code mode honor per agent code mode
item: Agents/code mode: honor per-agent code-mode config in schema, runtime catalog activation, and model payload filtering. Fixes #83388. Thanks @Kaspre.

sig: telegram apply method aware bot api request timeouts
item: Telegram: apply method-aware Bot API request timeouts to direct message/action clients so openclaw message delete --channel telegram no longer waits on grammY's 500-second default when the API request wedges. Fixes #81908. Thanks @DashLabsDev.

sig: slack add unfurllinks and unfurlmedia config for bot
item: Slack: add unfurlLinks and unfurlMedia config for bot chat.postMessage replies, including per-account overrides, so Slack link and media previews can be suppressed without workspace-wide settings. Fixes #48435. (#80145) Thanks @esegev1 and @HemantSudarshan.

sig: auto reply group chats fall back automatic source
item: Auto-reply/group chats: fall back to automatic source delivery when a channel precomputes message-tool-only replies but the message tool is unavailable, so Discord/Slack-style group turns do not silently complete without a visible reply. Fixes #74868. Thanks @kagura-agent.

sig: browser config allow local managed chrome launch discovery
item: Browser/config: allow local managed Chrome launch discovery and post-launch CDP readiness timeouts to be raised for slower hosts such as Raspberry Pi. Fixes #66803. Thanks @beat843796.

sig: agents failover classify generic api_error payloads retryable only
item: Agents/failover: classify generic api_error payloads as retryable only when they include transient failure signals, so MiniMax-style backend failures still trigger model fallback without misclassifying billing, auth, or format/context errors. (#49611) Thanks @ayushozha.

sig: ios testflight add local beta release flow with
item: iOS/TestFlight: add a local beta release flow with Fastlane prepare/archive/upload support, canonical beta bundle IDs, and watch-app archive fixes. (#42991) Thanks @ngutman.

sig: gateway restart fix restart loop edge cases keeping
item: Gateway/Restart: fix restart-loop edge cases by keeping openclaw.mjs -> dist/entry.js bootstrap detection explicit, reacquiring the gateway lock for in-process restart fallback paths, and tightening restart-loop regression coverage. (#23416) Thanks @jeffwnli.

sig: fixed http api workspace adapters losing instance context
item: Fixed HTTP API workspace adapters losing instance context, which could break workspace create, sync, and routing flows.

sig: fixed file search limit handling properly respect the
item: Fixed file search limit handling to properly respect the limit parameter when no query is provided

sig: fixed configuration precedence cli mode from low high
item: Fixed configuration precedence in CLI mode (from low to high: settings.json < workspace config.toml < command line parameters)

sig: fixed user message turn spacing interactive mode restoring
item: Fixed user-message turn spacing in interactive mode by restoring an inter-message spacer before user turns (except the first user message), preventing assistant and user blocks from rendering flush together.

sig: more kitty keyboard protocol fixes fixed backspace enter
item: More Kitty keyboard protocol fixes: Fixed Backspace, Enter, Home, End, and Delete keys not working with Caps Lock enabled. The initial fix in 0.24.1 missed several key handlers that were still using raw byte detection. Now all key handlers use the helper functions that properly mask out lock key bits.

sig: json mode stdout flush fixed race condition where
item: JSON mode stdout flush: Fixed race condition where pi --mode json could exit before all output was written to stdout, causing consumers to miss final events.

sig: adds machine readable convergence observation codes like root
item: Adds machine-readable convergence observation codes like root-cause-triage and batch-fixes to enable automated review actions.

sig: fixed the review cli bundle include the core
item: Fixed the review CLI bundle to include the core package build output, ensuring verification checks run correctly in review phases. (#8612) by @wenshao

sig: fixed issue where entering new search project search
item: Fixed an issue where entering a new search in project search would drop unsaved edits in the project search buffer.

sig: fixed crash that occurred when adding new file
item: Fixed a crash that occurred when adding a new file or directory to the first folded directory (#23217; thanks 0xtimsb).

sig: added message activity indicator last attempt format buffer
item: Added message to activity indicator if last attempt to format a buffer failed. Message will get reset when next formatting succeeds. Clicking on message opens log with more information. (#8072 and #9061).

sig: automatic upgrades are longer indefinitely blocked when multiple

item: Source Control - Revert All: Fixed an issue where "Revert All" could not handle both tracked changes and newly created files simultaneously. A single operation can now fully clean up.

sig: this published release and all failed publish due
item: This is a re-published release: v2.125.1, v2.125.2, and v2.125.3 all failed to publish due to release process anomalies, and the production environment remained at v2.125.0. v2.125.4 has been rebuilt and published, fully including all changes from the three aforementioned versions, plus a new interaction experience fix.

sig: safer process cleanup fixed issue where warmup eviction
item: Safer process cleanup: Fixed an issue where warmup eviction and process signal sending could accidentally affect other processes of the same user in edge cases. Additional multi-layer defensive checks have been added.

sig: missing responses mount point and symlink environments fixed
item: Missing AI responses in mount-point and symlink environments: Fixed an issue where a single conversation could be split across two directories when using virtual disk mounts or symlinks. Existing history is restored without manual migration

sig: iframe connection status occupied disconnected and unresponsive send
item: iframe connection status: Occupied, disconnected, and unresponsive-send states now show accurate messages and support retrying. Cold starts no longer report false disconnections, and rapid recovery no longer clears authorization for the new connection.

sig: security center and plan agent file prompts now
item: Security Center and Plan agent: File prompts now accurately distinguish reads, writes, and deletions. The Plan agent's read-only planning role and toolset are also clearer.

sig: accurate empty stream error messages when upstream model
item: Accurate empty-stream error messages: When an upstream model returns an empty response, the message now says “The model service returned no message” instead of incorrectly directing troubleshooting toward the local network.

sig: malformed json rpc message handling fixed issue where
item: Malformed JSON-RPC message handling: Fixed an issue where messages with an incorrect or truncated version number fell through to other channels in mixed mode, leaving callers unable to determine what happened. Messages containing characteristics of both protocols were previously treated as regular input and executed as a full turn; they now always return a protocol error and no longer enter the execution path. Plain-text questions and natural-language questions mentioning jsonrpc are unaffected.

sig: console output fixed issue where console output mode

sig: symlink support fixed issue where symlink files the

sig: media content error auto recovery when requests fail

sig: pipe input fixed issue where content could not
item: Pipe input: Fixed issue where content could not be read when using pipe input (e.g., cat file.txt | codebuddy -p "analyze")

sig: conversation compression identifier correction fixed issue where the

sig: environment configuration protection fixed issue where network environment

sig: wecom bot timeout fix adopted two phase reply
item: WeCom Bot Timeout Fix: Adopted a two-phase reply mechanism to avoid the 30s streaming timeout issue, allowing long-running Agent tasks to return results correctly.

sig: message queue processing fixed issue where accumulated user
item: Message Queue Processing: Fixed an issue where accumulated user messages in the queue could not be processed after timeout error handling, ensuring smooth conversation flow

sig: tls verification skip fixed the issue where disabling
item: TLS Verification Skip: Fixed the issue where disabling TLS verification did not take effect in non-proxy scenarios

sig: model settings sync fixed issue where options were

sig: model field fix fix the model field value

sig: non interactive mode tool control fixed behavior logic
item: Non-Interactive Mode Tool Control: Fixed behavior logic of user question-answer tool in non-interactive mode to ensure smooth automated workflow execution

sig: file lock recovery file locks are now immediately

sig: cursor coding agent for building ambitious software use
item: Cursor is a coding agent for building ambitious software. Use it to understand your codebase, plan and build features, fix bugs, review changes, and work with the tools you already use.

sig: your github repos can sit alongside the ones
item: Your GitHub repos can sit alongside the ones Cursor hosts. Connect GitHub to Cursor, pick your org, and you'll see the repos you can sync. Select one and Cursor pulls it in. You choose what gets synced and can disconnect a repo at any time. Anyone with read or write access to a synced repo can view it in Cursor too.

sig: you can now send message steer the agent
item: You can now send a message to steer the agent while it's working without interruption. Follow-ups wait for the next tool call instead of cutting the agent off mid-action.

sig: cursor supports self hosted machines which let you
item: Cursor supports self-hosted machines, which let you keep tool execution entirely in your own network.

sig: self hosted workers now support computer use linux
item: Self-hosted workers now support computer use on Linux and Mac. With the right desktop packages, an agent can click, type, take screenshots, and drive the browser. You can watch its desktop or take control from Cursor.

sig: cursor now port forwards your cloud agent live
item: Cursor now port-forwards your cloud agent's live environment straight to your browser, so you can preview it and use tools like design mode.

sig: team pools are named queues workers for team
item: Team pools are named queues of workers for a team or enterprise. Capacity can grow as requests arrive and shrink when workers disconnect, so your self-hosted machines can scale with demand. Pools are not tied to one repository: name the pool, and any available worker can claim the request.

sig: restore tool calling for custom openai compatible models

sig: graceful shutdown handshake timeout fallback teamdelete manual teammate
item: Graceful Shutdown Handshake + Timeout Fallback: On TeamDelete / manual teammate shutdown, the lead sends a shutdown request and waits for the teammate's response; if the teammate does not respond within the default 15 seconds, the process is automatically force-terminated, preventing stuck teammates from hanging the cleanup flow indefinitely

item: At Charm, we're all about creature comforts. This release contains a couple nice quality-of-life features and a handful of fixes, particularly around MCPs. Let’s see what’s new:

sig: shared conversation titles show file mention names instead
item: Shared conversation titles show file mention names instead of local file paths.

sig: removed the shift enter select type shortcut the
item: Removed the e / Shift+Enter “select+type” shortcut in the question tool. Explanations typed this way were silently dropped; use the “Other” option for custom text.

sig: devin worker start longer fails with http forbidden
item: devin worker start no longer fails with HTTP 403 Forbidden when bootstrapping a personal outpost from an enterprise CLI login.

sig: bug opens the bug submitter when run without
item: /bug opens the bug submitter when run without a description, rejects submissions from outdated CLI versions, and shows a checklist receipt of what was sent (with the local zip path for zero-data-retention accounts).

sig: ask and plan modes can use web search
item: Ask and Plan modes can use web search for read-only research when the tool is available.

sig: non utf command output reported with the real
item: Non-UTF-8 command output is reported with the real output and exit code.

sig: apply_patch longer rewrites whole windows crlf file line
item: apply_patch no longer rewrites a whole Windows (CRLF) file’s line endings to LF, so a one-line edit no longer produces a whole-file diff.

sig: attached images tell the model where the file
item: Attached images tell the model where the file lives on disk.

sig: pre user prompt hooks that exit with code
item: Pre-user-prompt hooks that exit with code 2 now correctly block the prompt instead of being silently ignored.

sig: usage command now shows quota remaining and overage
item: /usage command now shows quota % remaining and overage balance for quota-billing users instead of “no credits consumed.”

item: Prompt history opens while Devin is running, including when completions are visible.

sig: agents auto reply restrict no_reply prompt guidance automatic
item: Agents/auto-reply: restrict NO_REPLY prompt guidance to automatic group/channel replies, remove legacy silent-reply rewrites, and suppress accidental direct-chat silent tokens instead of delivering fallback text. Fixes #82254. Thanks @absol89.

sig: fix canvas validate snapshot response formats thanks

sig: discord streaming only mark partial draft previews delivered

sig: telegram skip unmentioned group media before download when
item: Telegram: skip unmentioned group media before download when requireMention is active, avoiding failed media-download replies for messages that should be ignored. Fixes #81181. (#81785) Thanks @joshavant.

sig: auto reply surface visible error when the configured
item: Auto-reply: surface a visible error when the configured model backend fails and fallback produces no visible reply, while preserving intentional silent turns and side-effect-only deliveries. (#80917) Thanks @dutifulbob.

sig: feishu fall back top level group send when
item: Feishu: fall back to a top-level group send when normal group quoted replies target a withdrawn or missing message, preventing replies from disappearing silently while preserving native topic safety. Fixes #79349. Thanks @arlen8411.

sig: doctor stop flagging the live compatibility agent directory
item: Doctor: stop flagging the live compatibility agent directory as orphaned when the configured default agent is not main. Fixes #74313. (#74438) Thanks @carlos4s.

sig: agents telegram deliver the canonical final assistant answer
item: Agents/Telegram: deliver the canonical final assistant answer instead of replaying accumulated pre-tool text blocks, preventing duplicate Telegram replies and raw-looking tool-output fragments from leaking into chat delivery. Fixes #79621 and #79986. Thanks @nonzeroclaw and @dudaefj.

sig: whatsapp route proactive phone number sends through baileys
item: WhatsApp: route proactive phone-number sends through Baileys LID forward mappings when available, so LID-addressed contacts receive agent messages instead of creating sender-only ghost chats. Fixes #67378. (#74925) Thanks @edenfunf.

sig: ios pairing allow setup code and manual connects
item: iOS pairing: allow setup-code and manual ws:// connects for private LAN and .local gateways while keeping Tailscale/public routes on wss://, and prefer explicit gateway passwords over stale bootstrap tokens in mixed-auth reconnects. Fixes #47887; carries forward #65185. Thanks @draix and @BunsDev.

sig: gateway systemd preserve operator added secrets the gateway
item: Gateway/systemd: preserve operator-added secrets in the Gateway env file across re-stage while clearing OpenClaw-managed keys (such as OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN) so a fresh staging value is never shadowed by a stale env-file copy; operator secrets are also retained when the state-dir .env is empty. Fixes #76860. Thanks @hclsys.

sig: cache require the full cache suffix marker before
item: QA/cache: require the full CACHE-OK <suffix> marker before live cache probes stop retrying, so suffix-only prose cannot hide a broken probe response. Thanks @vincentkoc.

sig: gateway update recover installed but unloaded macos launchagent
item: Gateway/update: recover an installed-but-unloaded macOS LaunchAgent after package updates, rerun Gateway health/version/channel readiness checks, and print restart, reinstall, and rollback guidance before reporting update failure. (#76790) Thanks @jonathanlindsay.

sig: gateway systemd exit with sysexits for supervised lock
item: Gateway/systemd: exit with sysexits 78 for supervised lock and EADDRINUSE conflicts so RestartPreventExitStatus=78 stops Restart=always restart loops instead of repeatedly reloading plugins against an occupied port. Fixes #75115. Thanks @yhyatt.

sig: signal derive getattachment http response caps from channels
item: Signal: derive getAttachment HTTP response caps from channels.signal.mediaMaxMb with base64 headroom, so inbound photos and videos no longer drop behind the 1 MiB RPC default. Fixes #73564. Thanks @heyhudson.

sig: media treat legacy word ole attachments with application
item: Media: treat legacy Word/OLE attachments with application/msword or application/x-cfb MIME as binary so printable-looking .doc files are not embedded into prompts as text. Fixes #54176; carries forward #54380. Thanks @andyliu.

sig: browser playwright ignore benign already handled route races
